chunks: And say: 'My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the evil promptings of the devils.'
ai.seo_question: What does it mean to seek refuge from the evil promptings of the devils in Islam?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often recited during prayer and daily devotion as a shield against both external satanic influences and internal egoic distractions (waswasa). It underscores the believer's reliance on divine grace to maintain spiritual clarity and focus on the path of righteousness amidst life's trials.
